entities.name: Query PEPC
observations: 768 aa soluble enzyme-like protein; calculated molecular mass 84.23 kDa and pI 5.64.
Contains Pfam PEPcase (PF00311.24) across positions 15–768 with i-Evalue 1.9e-255.
Matches reviewed phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase A1R2V3 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
Best-supported function is phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase, EC 4.1.1.31; sequence evidence supports annotation but does not independently establish kinetic parameters.

entities.name: PEP carboxylation
observations: Rhea RHEA:28370 records the reversible reaction oxaloacetate + phosphate ⇌ phosphoenolpyruvate + hydrogencarbonate; the physiological forward direction is phosphoenolpyruvate + hydrogencarbonate → oxaloacetate + phosphate.

entities.name: Magnesium ion
observations: Mg2+ is annotated as a required cofactor for the matched phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylases; the query is therefore inferred to use Mg2+ in catalysis.
This cofactor assignment is homology-based for the query sequence, not a direct assay of the supplied protein.

entities.name: Oxaloacetate metabolism
observations: Matched PEPC proteins are annotated in oxaloacetate metabolism, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and carbon fixation.
The enzyme replenishes oxaloacetate, a four-carbon dicarboxylate used in central metabolism.
